{{Current events|year=2019|month=09|day=12|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Diyarbakır bombing]]
**Seven civilians are killed and nine are injured, two of whom critically, in a roadside attack by the [[PKK]] in the southeastern [[Turkey|Turkish]] city of [[Diyarbakir]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/turkey/pkk-terrorist-attack-in-se-turkey-kills-7-civilians-/1580369 (Anadolu Agency)] 

;Business and economy
*The [[European Central Bank]] announces new [[Monetary policy|monetary]] [[Stimulus (economics)|stimulus]], with a second round of [[Quantitative easing#Eurozone_and_Switzerland|quantitative easing]] "for as long as it deems necessary" and lowering its already-[[Negative interest on excess reserves#Europe|negative]] main deposit rate. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/09/12/european-central-bank-launches-new-bond-buying-program.html (CNBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A train derails in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]'s [[Tanganyika Province]], killing at least 50 people and injuring 23 others. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/congo-train-derail-death-toll-latest-minister-steve-mbikay-a9102401.html (''The Independent'')]

;Law and crime
*The [[National Assembly (France)|French National Assembly]] says its [[List of presidents of the National Assembly of France|president]], [[Richard Ferrand]], is put under formal investigation in a "financial impropriety" case. Ferrand stepped down as a [[Minister of Territorial Development (France)|minister]] in [[President of France|President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]]'s [[Government of France|government]] in 2017 over the case related to property deals, eight years ago, by a health insurance fund he managed in [[Brittany (administrative region)|Brittany]]. Prosecutors in [[Lille]] say he is charged with a [[conflict of interest]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/20190912-frances-national-assembly-leader-macron-ally-investigated-graft-probe (Reuters via France 24)] [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/french-assembly-chief-and-macron-ally-probed-over-property-deals (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
*[[Sahar Khodayari|Death of Sahar Khodayari]]
**Iran's [[Judicial system of Iran|judiciary]] issues a warrant to arrest actress [[Saba Kamali]] after she posted a text in her Instagram sympathizing with [[Sahar Khodayari]], which was reported to be found "insulting" to the third Shiite Imam, Hussain ibn Ali. [https://en.radiofarda.com/amp/30160647.html (Radio Farda)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Tonga]]n [[Prime Minister of Tonga|Prime Minister]] [[ʻAkilisi Pōhiva]], age 78, dies one day after being taken to a [[New Zealand]] hospital from his native country. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/pacific/398621/tongan-pm-akilisi-pohiva-dies-aged-78 (RNZ)]
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential debates and forums|2020 U.S. Democratic Party presidential debates and forums]]
**The third major [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic Party]] televised debate takes place at the [[Health and Physical Education Arena]] in [[Houston]], [[Texas]], with a focus on [[health care in the United States]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-49684419 (BBC)]

;Science and technology
*[[Interstellar object]]s
**[[C/2019 Q4 (Borisov)]], a second [[interstellar comet]] after [[ʻOumuamua]] in 2017, is discovered by an amateur astronomer. [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-49676757 (BBC)]
*[[Social media use in politics]]
**[[Twitter]] [[Twitter suspensions|suspends]] several [[Cuba]]n government and [[state media]] accounts, including [[First Secretary of the Communist Party of Cuba]] [[Raúl Castro]] and his daughter [[Mariela Castro]]. The pro-government [[Union of Journalists of Cuba]] denounces the suspensions as "massive censorship". [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/sep/12/twitter-raul-castro-state-media-outlets-blocked (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-49683029 (BBC)]
**[[Facebook]] suspends a chatbot on [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]]'s official page for violating its [[hate speech]] policy. Netanyahu says the mistake was made by a volunteer employee. [https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2019/sep/12/facebook-disables-netanyahu-page-bot-over-hate-speech-violation (''The Guardian)]
